purpose: Extend a description to every part by naming representative parts.
keywords: N + といわず + N + といわず
There was mud everywhere, on the floor, the walls, and all.
There is paint all over my hands, face, and everywhere else.
Calls come at all hours, day and night.
formation: N + といわず + N + といわず
restrictions: Typically followed by a condition covering the whole.
mistake: Unlike といい, this strongly suggests everywhere or throughout.
